name: Aurora Nelson
source:
Aurora never really had friends. Even after transitioning, she found that things were simpler if she just kept to herself. Her one biggest pleasure in life? Exterminating ghosts. Aurora hates those damn pests and takes great pleasure in watching them squirm.

So when Nicole holes up in her apartment, Aurora wants her out. NOW.
